strings.zh: 修一
strings.en: Jack
strings.notes: 修一 not in 0719; US contact Schoolboy Jack (US 0704)

strings.zh: 不过你的知识{NEWLINE}还真是了不起啊,{CLEAR}我很欣赏你！{SCROLL}为了能多赢几场战斗,{NEWLINE}我们来交换情报吧。{SCROLL}我一旦有什么情报{NEWLINE}就会打电话告诉你的。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Your knowledge is really{NEWLINE}impressive. I like that!{SCROLL}So we can win more battles,{NEWLINE}let’s trade information.{SCROLL}As soon as I hear anything,{NEWLINE}I’ll call and tell you.{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 等我有了什么情报{NEWLINE}我就打电话给你！
strings.en: I’ll call you if I hear anything!

strings.zh: 是吗,真是遗憾⋯⋯{NEWLINE}不过下次想登陆的时候{CLEAR}就再来找我吧。
strings.en: Oh, OK. Too bad...{SCROLL}Well, if you ever want my number,{NEWLINE}come and see me, OK?

strings.zh: 为了能多赢几场战斗,{NEWLINE}我们来交换情报吧。{SCROLL}我一旦有什么情报{NEWLINE}就会打电话告诉你的。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: So we can win more battles,{NEWLINE}let’s trade information.{SCROLL}As soon as I hear anything,{NEWLINE}I’ll call and tell you.{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 怎么了？{NEWLINE}我们离得这么近,{CLEAR}干嘛不直接来找我谈话啊！
strings.en: What’s going on?{NEWLINE}We’re pretty close... Why not just come{CLEAR}and talk in person?

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}突然变聪明了！{CLEAR}可能比你的精灵更聪明哦,{SCROLL}再见！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} suddenly got smarter!{NEWLINE}It might be smarter than your Pokémon.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 之前我轻松打倒了{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}和你交换情报的{NEWLINE}好处显现出来了吗？{SCROLL}再见！
strings.en: The other day, I easily defeated a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}.{SCROLL}I think swapping tips with you is{NEWLINE}starting to help.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 之前我就差一点就能抓到{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}了⋯⋯{SCROLL}我的知识要是能再多一点的话{NEWLINE}一定就能抓到它了⋯⋯{SCROLL}再见！
strings.en: I missed catching a wild {VAR:0100:11} by{NEWLINE}just a tiny bit.{SCROLL}If I’d been more informed, I’m{NEWLINE}sure I would’ve caught it...{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}下雨的时候,{NEWLINE}闪电命中会上升。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}When it’s raining, Thunder{NEWLINE}is more likely to hit.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}使用变圆后再用滚动{CLEAR}就能提升滚动的威力。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}If you use Defense Curl, Rollout’s{NEWLINE}power goes way up past normal.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}在烈日下阳光烈焰不用蓄气。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}In harsh sunlight, Solar Beam{NEWLINE}doesn’t need to charge up.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}在对手变小的时候{NEWLINE}就能提升践踏的威力。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}If the opponent uses Minimize, your{NEWLINE}Stomp becomes more powerful.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}在对手飞在天上的时候{NEWLINE}使出起风{CLEAR}就能提升起风的威力。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}If you use Gust while your{NEWLINE}opponent is up in the sky,{CLEAR}Gust becomes more powerful.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}在对手飞在天上的时候{NEWLINE}使出龙卷风{CLEAR}就能提升龙卷风的威力。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}If you use Twister while your{NEWLINE}opponent is up in the sky,{CLEAR}Twister becomes more powerful.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}在对手钻入地下的时候{NEWLINE}使出地震{CLEAR}就能提升地震的威力。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}If you use Earthquake while your{NEWLINE}opponent is underground,{CLEAR}Earthquake becomes more powerful.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}在对手钻入地下的时候{NEWLINE}使出震级变化{CLEAR}就能提升震级变化的威力。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}If you use Magnitude while your{NEWLINE}opponent is underground,{CLEAR}Magnitude becomes more powerful.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}岩石,地面,钢铁三系的精灵{NEWLINE}在沙暴中也不会受到伤害。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type Pokémon{NEWLINE}don’t take damage in a sandstorm.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}在烈日下,{NEWLINE}水系技能会比平时更弱。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}If the sunlight is harsh, Water-type{NEWLINE}moves become much weaker.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{SCROLL}在下雨的时候{NEWLINE}火系技能会比平时更弱。
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}When it’s raining, Fire-type moves{NEWLINE}become much weaker than usual.

strings.zh: 我说,要来场对战吗？{NEWLINE}我会让你见识到{CLEAR}我灵活运用知识的战术！{SCROLL}我会在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}等你到了就来找我吧！
strings.en: Hey, want to battle? I’ll{NEWLINE}show you tactics that put{CLEAR}knowledge to good use!{SCROLL}I’ll be at {VAR:0104:3}.{NEWLINE}Come find me when you get here!

strings.zh: 啊！{VAR:0103:0}！{SCROLL}你还记得我们的约定吗？{NEWLINE}快来对战吧！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: Hey, {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}Do you remember your promise?{NEWLINE}We have to battle soon!{SCROLL}I’ll be at {VAR:0104:3}.

strings.zh: 啊！{VAR:0103:0}！{SCROLL}你还记得我们的约定吗？{NEWLINE}快来对战吧！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: Hey, {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}Do you remember your promise?{NEWLINE}We have to battle soon!{SCROLL}I’ll be at {VAR:0104:3}.

strings.zh: 我从我的朋友{NEWLINE}那儿打听到了些情报,{SCROLL}想找个人分享一下。{NEWLINE}你要是想知道的话{CLEAR}我就告诉你吧！
strings.en: I got some info from a friend of mine,{SCROLL}and I want to share it with someone.{NEWLINE}If you want to know, I’ll tell you!
